question: Can the current public VFGS frequency-filtering cutoff family preserve most of the retained P4BS scanner-convolved Thomas NPS and ACF improvement as a compact standards-compatible runtime profile shape?

fga_nn.title: Film Grain Analysis and Synthesis via Neural Network
fga_nn.use: Primary evidence that a learned analyzer may predict explicit conventional FGC-SEI amplitude and frequency-cutoff parameters; no paper model or weights are used here.

roles.development: all eight exact P4R colour uniform scans; select one integer cutoff independently for the fixed soft and rectangular windows
roles.confirmation: all three exact P4Z1 B&W uniform scans; read only after both cutoff choices and the unchanged P4BS Gaussian/Thomas controls are frozen

model.family: VFGS FGC-SEI frequency-filtering mode, isotropic horizontal/vertical cutoff and shape-only comparison
model.window_formula: exact vfgs_init_window cutoff table; separable expected power is squared horizontal window times squared vertical window
model.frequency_mapping: absolute DFT cycles/pixel divided by Nyquist, then nearest 64-bin VFGS center
model.fit_space: normalized centered log radial band power
model.acf: unit-zero-lag inverse DFT of the 512x512 separable expected power

branch_rule.pass: Retain the exact fixed-K VFGS cutoff family as a compact standards-compatible approximation to the generic P4BS second-order shape and open direct public-source C parity plus bounded profile compilation; do not change physical ordering or claim microscopic grain.
branch_rule.fail: Retain VFGS/FGA-NN only as an implementation baseline, keep the P4BS effective Thomas spectrum, and do not tune K, cutoff range, bands, controls or gates on these cohorts.

forbidden: treat this runtime approximation as a new point-process or microscopic film mechanism
fit K, frequency mapping, bands, controls or gates after reading confirmation
train or execute FGA-NN, or use a learned model to generate final RGB
claim density-domain placement, stock/process/scanner calibration or product promotion
replace the typed physical grain order with post-code additive video grain
claim_ceiling: Compact standards-compatible spectral approximation test against retained same-scanner second-order evidence; not a microscopic, stock, process, density, scanner-independent, photographic-render or product result.
